{{Otheruses|Zed}}
'''Zed''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin system]] who often competed in [[Flight simulator/Legends|Holosimulator]] combat scenarios against veteran pilot [[Jayeena]] some time after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The pair also created their own combat simulator scenarios. Despite being a less experienced pilot than Jayeena, Zed believed he was a smarter one. One of their competitions resulted in the "Zed vs. Jayeena" holosimulator skirmish template.
